 Dengue claims 3 more lives in 24hrs, toll hits 513 
 A total of 1,347 new dengue patients were hospitalised across the country in the 24 hours. 
 TBS Report 
 20 November, 2026, 07:55 pm 
 Last modified: 20 November, 2026, 07:59 pm 
 Representational Photo/UNB "> 
 Representational Photo/UNB 
 The health directorate has recorded three more deaths from dengue across the country in the 24 hours preceding 8am today (20 November), taking this year's death toll to 513. 
 According to the daily update of the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), 1,347 dengue patients were admitted to hospitals across the country during the same period.
 Two of the deceased were from Chattogram Division, while one was from Barishal Division.
 Keep updated, follow The Business Standard's Google news channel
 Meanwhile, 1,344 dengue patients were discharged from hospitals in the 24 hours preceding 8am today, taking the total number of recoveries this year to 164,150.
 The cumulative number of dengue cases reported across the country has reached 170,280.
 A total of 5,617 dengue patients are currently receiving treatment at hospitals.
